PAT-ALG-DECIMAL-DIGITS-001: Fix numeric palindrome comparison: use the full reversed value, not the 16-bit packed summary.
PAT-ALG-COUNTING-SORT-001: Do not underflow exhausted frequency counters.
PAT-DS-CIRCULAR-QUEUE-001: Validate head, tail and count before a buffer access.
PAT-DS-RING-BUFFER-001: Validate head, tail and count before a buffer access.
PAT-DS-STACK-001: Reject a corrupted top index for pop as well as push.
PAT-DS-LINKED-LIST-001: Reject self-insertion, which otherwise creates a cycle.
PAT-ALG-FLOOD-FILL-001: Reject zero columns and overflowing matrix dimensions before address arithmetic.
PAT-ALG-BFS-001: Bound matrix indexing; recursive DFS additionally has an explicit 256-vertex stack-depth bound.
PAT-ALG-DIJKSTRA-001: Bound matrix indexing; recursive DFS additionally has an explicit 256-vertex stack-depth bound.
PAT-ALG-RECURSIVE-DFS-001: Bound matrix indexing; recursive DFS additionally has an explicit 256-vertex stack-depth bound.
Validate a directly called recursive helper before indexing seen.
PAT-ALG-DFS-STACK-001: Mark vertices when pushed so duplicate pending entries cannot exhaust the n-element stack and drop reachable vertices.
PAT-ALG-COIN-CHANGE-001: Validate scratch and coin pointers; prevent amount+1 wrap and word-address overflow.
PAT-ALG-KNAPSACK-001: Reject invalid pointers and oversized DP dimensions; bound item-value sums to 32 bits.
PAT-ALG-HISTOGRAM-MODE-001: Validate histogram storage and byte-domain range.
PAT-ALG-MOVING-AVERAGE-001: Validate pointers and prevent unsigned windows from becoming a negative signed divisor.
PAT-ALG-EDIT-DISTANCE-001: Prevent increment wrap and reject aliasing scratch rows.
Reject wrapped row count and tables whose word offsets exceed the address range.
PAT-ALG-ARRAY-REVERSAL-001: Make a null input a no-op rather than dereferencing it.
PAT-ALG-BUBBLE-SORT-001: Make a null input a no-op rather than dereferencing it.
PAT-ALG-SELECTION-SORT-001: Make a null input a no-op rather than dereferencing it.
PAT-ALG-HEAP-SORT-001: Make a null input a no-op rather than dereferencing it.
Stop heap descent at a leaf before child-index arithmetic.
PAT-ALG-QUICKSORT-001: Reject unsigned lengths not representable by the signed partition indexes.
PAT-ALG-MERGE-SORT-001: Reject identical scratch and input buffers.
PAT-ALG-MEMMOVE-001: Use integer addresses for ordering distinct objects and guard null pointers.
Avoid relational comparison between pointers to unrelated objects.
PAT-ALG-ARRAY-ROTATION-001: Reject identical scratch and input buffers.
PAT-ALG-STRING-PRIMITIVES-001: Avoid overflow in substring bound checking.
PAT-ALG-PREFIX-SUM-001: Reject prefix arrays whose count+1 or byte offsets cannot be represented.
PAT-ALG-HORNER-001: Define legacy Horner wraparound explicitly, avoiding C signed-overflow undefined behavior.
PAT-ALG-WIDE-DIVISION-001: Avoid negating INT64_MIN in C. INT64_MIN/-1 retains the existing INT64_MIN bit-pattern result; document the overflow case.
PAT-ALG-REDUCTION-001: Add the missing unsigned-reduction ARM export already present in C and its tests.
PAT-ALG-INDIRECT-RECURRENCE-001: Validate computed Hofstadter dependency indexes and addition; supply its missing ARM entry point.
PAT-DATA-ASM-OBJECTS-001: Export the canonical C data names and magic constant, preserving old aliases.
